LESSON: DIMENSIONING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.2: Dimensioning

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Dimensioning
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is dimensioning applied in drawings?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the types of dimensioning in drawing
2. draw lines used for dimensioning in drawing

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify the types of dimensioning in drawing

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify the types of dimensioning in drawing.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify the types of dimensioning in drawing” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify the types of dimensioning in drawing” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify the types of dimensioning in drawing" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: draw lines used for dimensioning in drawing

Teach
• Today’s focus: draw lines used for dimensioning in drawing.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model A for “draw lines used for dimensioning in drawing” using a school example.
• Model B for “draw lines used for dimensioning in drawing” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "draw lines used for dimensioning in drawing" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify the types of dimensioning in drawing
• Model 2: draw lines used for dimensioning in drawing

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify the types of dimensioning in drawing
2. Practise: draw lines used for dimensioning in drawing

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Dimensioning.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is dimensioning applied in drawings?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify the types of dimensioning in drawing
• draw lines used for dimensioning in drawing
